JNG-06.D.title_zh: 同时规划木条顺序与接近方向 · Stretch
JNG-06.D.title_en: Plan block order together with access direction · Stretch
JNG-06.D.description_zh: 三轮操作同时受到可移除性、塔顶槽位和身体可接近侧的限制。Stretch 需要随着塔体变化安排单伸缩臂的接触与转向，避免后续动作失去空间。
JNG-06.D.description_en: Three rounds combine removability, top-slot and accessible-side constraints. Stretch must coordinate contact and turning as the tower changes without blocking later moves.
JNG-06.D.goal_zh: 完成3轮合法木条抽取与塔顶重放，撤手后保持结构稳定。
JNG-06.D.goal_en: Complete 3 legal block extractions and top placements, leaving the structure stable after release.
conditions_zh: 三轮操作同时受到可移除性、塔顶槽位和身体可接近侧的限制。Stretch 需要随着塔体变化安排单伸缩臂的接触与转向，避免后续动作失去空间。
conditions_en: Three rounds combine removability, top-slot and accessible-side constraints. Stretch must coordinate contact and turning as the tower changes without blocking later moves.

FT-ORIG.G.title_zh: 把三只易碎烧瓶送到相邻桌面
FT-ORIG.G.title_en: Move three fragile flasks to the adjacent table
FT-ORIG.G.description_zh: 三只没有颈环的烧瓶需要从一张桌子转移到另一张，现场只提供一种运输盒。G1 三指手需要控制挤压与冲击，使烧瓶在目标区完好直立并稳定释放。
FT-ORIG.G.description_en: Three flasks without neck rings must move between adjacent tables with one transport-box type available. G1’s three-finger hands must avoid crushing and impact before upright stable delivery.
FT-ORIG.G.scope_zh: 固定骨盆，采用原烧瓶和原损伤规则；本片为特权参考的独立动作回放。工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态；主体位姿和已记录机器人关节沿用实测数据。
FT-ORIG.G.scope_en: Fixed pelvis with original flasks and damage rules; this video is an independent action replay of a privileged reference. Unrecorded passive joints inside the tools use authored rest poses; main-body poses and recorded robot joints retain the measured data.
FT-ORIG.G.goal_zh: 将三只烧瓶完好、直立地交付到目标区，释放后保持稳定。
FT-ORIG.G.goal_en: Deliver all three flasks intact and upright into the goal area, then release them stably.
conditions_zh: 三只没有颈环的烧瓶需要从一张桌子转移到另一张，现场只提供一种运输盒。G1 三指手需要控制挤压与冲击，使烧瓶在目标区完好直立并稳定释放。
conditions_en: Three flasks without neck rings must move between adjacent tables with one transport-box type available. G1’s three-finger hands must avoid crushing and impact before upright stable delivery.

FT-L1.F.title_zh: 五指手搬运带颈环烧瓶
FT-L1.F.title_en: Move neck-ring flasks with five-finger hands
FT-L1.F.description_zh: 烧瓶增加了可接触的颈环，身体换装五指手，目标仍是完整交付三瓶。机器人需要根据手部几何和公开损伤规则安排抓持与释放，避免压碎瓶身。
FT-L1.F.description_en: Neck rings are added and the body uses five-finger hands. The robot must use hand geometry and declared damage rules to deliver all three flasks without crushing them.
FT-L1.F.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1 Inspire；烧瓶结构与原无颈环配置不同。工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态；主体位姿和已记录机器人关节沿用实测数据。
FT-L1.F.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1 Inspire; flask geometry differs from the original ringless configuration. Unrecorded passive joints inside the tools use authored rest poses; main-body poses and recorded robot joints retain the measured data.
FT-L1.F.goal_zh: 将三只烧瓶完好、直立地交付到目标区，释放后保持稳定。
FT-L1.F.goal_en: Deliver all three flasks intact and upright into the goal area, then release them stably.
conditions_zh: 烧瓶增加了可接触的颈环，身体换装五指手，目标仍是完整交付三瓶。机器人需要根据手部几何和公开损伤规则安排抓持与释放，避免压碎瓶身。
conditions_en: Neck rings are added and the body uses five-finger hands. The robot must use hand geometry and declared damage rules to deliver all three flasks without crushing them.

FT-L1.S.title_zh: Stretch 在两桌间转运烧瓶
FT-L1.S.title_en: Stretch transfers flasks between two tables
FT-L1.S.description_zh: 两张桌子之间隔着通道，Stretch 只有一条伸缩臂，现场有多种承托工具。机器人要协调底盘转向与夹爪接触，让三只烧瓶完整落在目标桌上。
FT-L1.S.description_en: A passage separates the tables, and Stretch has one telescoping arm with several support tools available. Base turning and gripper contact must deliver three intact flasks.
FT-L1.S.scope_zh: 工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态；主体位姿和已记录机器人关节沿用实测数据。
FT-L1.S.scope_en: Unrecorded passive joints inside the tools use authored rest poses; main-body poses and recorded robot joints retain the measured data.
FT-L1.S.goal_zh: 将三只烧瓶完好、直立地交付到目标区，释放后保持稳定。
FT-L1.S.goal_en: Deliver all three flasks intact and upright into the goal area, then release them stably.
conditions_zh: 两张桌子之间隔着通道，Stretch 只有一条伸缩臂，现场有多种承托工具。机器人要协调底盘转向与夹爪接触，让三只烧瓶完整落在目标桌上。
conditions_en: A passage separates the tables, and Stretch has one telescoping arm with several support tools available. Base turning and gripper contact must deliver three intact flasks.

FT-L1.W.title_zh: 轮式双臂短距离搬运烧瓶
FT-L1.W.title_en: A wheeled dual-arm robot moves flasks a short distance
FT-L1.W.description_zh: 两张桌子相距一点五米，现场只有运输盒，能力和工具条件均公开。R1 需要兼顾双臂承托、底盘运动和轻柔落放，把三只烧瓶完好交付。
FT-L1.W.description_en: The tables are 1.5 m apart with only a transport box and declared capabilities. R1 must coordinate two-arm support, base motion and gentle placement of three intact flasks.
FT-L1.W.scope_zh: 工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态；主体位姿和已记录机器人关节沿用实测数据。
FT-L1.W.scope_en: Unrecorded passive joints inside the tools use authored rest poses; main-body poses and recorded robot joints retain the measured data.
FT-L1.W.goal_zh: 将三只烧瓶完好、直立地交付到目标区，释放后保持稳定。
FT-L1.W.goal_en: Deliver all three flasks intact and upright into the goal area, then release them stably.
conditions_zh: 两张桌子相距一点五米，现场只有运输盒，能力和工具条件均公开。R1 需要兼顾双臂承托、底盘运动和轻柔落放，把三只烧瓶完好交付。
conditions_en: The tables are 1.5 m apart with only a transport box and declared capabilities. R1 must coordinate two-arm support, base motion and gentle placement of three intact flasks.

FT-A.G.title_zh: 从多种工具中找到短程搬运方法
FT-A.G.title_en: Find a short-range flask transport method
FT-A.G.description_zh: 多种盒、托架和辅助工具同时在场，接口几何公开但与身体的相容性未知。G1 需要判断哪些接触可实际执行，在短距离内交付三只完整烧瓶。
FT-A.G.description_en: Boxes, racks and aids are present with visible interfaces but undisclosed body compatibility. G1 must identify executable contacts for short-range delivery of three intact flasks.
FT-A.G.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1 Dex3，使用扩展烧瓶。工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态；主体位姿和已记录机器人关节沿用实测数据。
FT-A.G.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1 Dex3 with the extended flask geometry. Unrecorded passive joints inside the tools use authored rest poses; main-body poses and recorded robot joints retain the measured data.
FT-A.G.goal_zh: 将三只烧瓶完好、直立地交付到目标区，释放后保持稳定。
FT-A.G.goal_en: Deliver all three flasks intact and upright into the goal area, then release them stably.
conditions_zh: 多种盒、托架和辅助工具同时在场，接口几何公开但与身体的相容性未知。G1 需要判断哪些接触可实际执行，在短距离内交付三只完整烧瓶。
conditions_en: Boxes, racks and aids are present with visible interfaces but undisclosed body compatibility. G1 must identify executable contacts for short-range delivery of three intact flasks.

FT-A.S.title_zh: 单臂机器人判断搬运工具是否合用
FT-A.S.title_en: A single-arm robot evaluates transport tools
FT-A.S.description_zh: 桌间距离允许一次转身接近，现场却有多种接口相容性未知的工具。Stretch 要结合单臂可达范围与烧瓶损伤规则，选择可执行的三瓶交付方式。
FT-A.S.description_en: The tables are reachable with one turn, but several tools have undisclosed interface compatibility. Stretch must combine single-arm reach with damage constraints for three-flask delivery.
FT-A.S.scope_zh: 工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态；主体位姿和已记录机器人关节沿用实测数据。
FT-A.S.scope_en: Unrecorded passive joints inside the tools use authored rest poses; main-body poses and recorded robot joints retain the measured data.
FT-A.S.goal_zh: 将三只烧瓶完好、直立地交付到目标区，释放后保持稳定。
FT-A.S.goal_en: Deliver all three flasks intact and upright into the goal area, then release them stably.
conditions_zh: 桌间距离允许一次转身接近，现场却有多种接口相容性未知的工具。Stretch 要结合单臂可达范围与烧瓶损伤规则，选择可执行的三瓶交付方式。
conditions_en: The tables are reachable with one turn, but several tools have undisclosed interface compatibility. Stretch must combine single-arm reach with damage constraints for three-flask delivery.

FT-B.G.title_zh: 行走 G1 搬运预装整盒烧瓶
FT-B.G.title_en: Walking G1 carries a preloaded flask box
FT-B.G.description_zh: 三只烧瓶已放入运输盒，路线包含直角转弯和地缝。G1 要在步行与落座过程中控制载荷姿态和冲击，把整盒货物送入目标区后释放。
FT-B.G.description_en: Three flasks start inside a transport box on a route with a right-angle turn and floor gap. Walking G1 must control load pose and impact before releasing the whole box.
FT-B.G.scope_zh: 预装整盒运输的修订目标，不包含从起点桌装瓶或逐瓶卸载。工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态，主体和机器人运动沿用实测数据；墙面以原边界线框显示。
FT-B.G.scope_en: Revised preloaded whole-box transport goal; pickup from the source table and individual unloading are excluded. Unrecorded passive tool joints use authored rest poses while body and robot motion retain measured data; walls are shown as outlines at their original bounds.
FT-B.G.goal_zh: 运送预装三瓶的整盒货物，在目标区放下并释放运输盒，保持三瓶完好直立。
FT-B.G.goal_en: Transport the preloaded three-flask carrier, place and release the carrier in the goal, and keep every flask intact and upright.
conditions_zh: 三只烧瓶已放入运输盒，路线包含直角转弯和地缝。G1 要在步行与落座过程中控制载荷姿态和冲击，把整盒货物送入目标区后释放。
conditions_en: Three flasks start inside a transport box on a route with a right-angle turn and floor gap. Walking G1 must control load pose and impact before releasing the whole box.

FT-B.S.title_zh: 单臂机器人完成长程三瓶转运
FT-B.S.title_en: A single-arm robot transports three flasks over a long route
FT-B.S.description_zh: 八米路线带有转角和地缝，三只烧瓶需要在公开时间预算内完整交付。Stretch 要在运输盒、单瓶工具和托架之间权衡承托方式与往返次数。
FT-B.S.description_en: An 8 m route includes a corner and floor gap within a declared time budget. Stretch must consider box, individual-flask and rack support options together with trip count.
FT-B.S.scope_zh: 工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态，主体和机器人运动沿用实测数据；障碍物采用剖视显示，原碰撞边界与轨迹不变。
FT-B.S.scope_en: Unrecorded passive tool joints use authored rest poses while body and robot motion retain measured data; obstacles use a cutaway view without changing collision bounds or trajectories.
FT-B.S.goal_zh: 将三只烧瓶完好、直立地交付到目标区，释放后保持稳定。
FT-B.S.goal_en: Deliver all three flasks intact and upright into the goal area, then release them stably.
conditions_zh: 八米路线带有转角和地缝，三只烧瓶需要在公开时间预算内完整交付。Stretch 要在运输盒、单瓶工具和托架之间权衡承托方式与往返次数。
conditions_en: An 8 m route includes a corner and floor gap within a declared time budget. Stretch must consider box, individual-flask and rack support options together with trip count.

FT-B.W.title_zh: 轮式双臂在长路线中转运烧瓶
FT-B.W.title_en: A dual-arm mobile robot transports flasks over a long route
FT-B.W.description_zh: 长路线包含直角转弯与地缝，工具的接口可见但相容性没有直接给出。R1 需要综合双臂承托、运输效率和落放冲击，完整交付三只烧瓶。
FT-B.W.description_en: A long route has a right-angle turn and floor gap, with visible but unlabelled tool compatibility. R1 must balance support, travel time and placement impact for intact delivery.
FT-B.W.scope_zh: 工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态，主体和机器人运动沿用实测数据；障碍物采用剖视显示，原碰撞边界与轨迹不变。
FT-B.W.scope_en: Unrecorded passive tool joints use authored rest poses while body and robot motion retain measured data; obstacles use a cutaway view without changing collision bounds or trajectories.
FT-B.W.goal_zh: 将三只烧瓶完好、直立地交付到目标区，释放后保持稳定。
FT-B.W.goal_en: Deliver all three flasks intact and upright into the goal area, then release them stably.
conditions_zh: 长路线包含直角转弯与地缝，工具的接口可见但相容性没有直接给出。R1 需要综合双臂承托、运输效率和落放冲击，完整交付三只烧瓶。
conditions_en: A long route has a right-angle turn and floor gap, with visible but unlabelled tool compatibility. R1 must balance support, travel time and placement impact for intact delivery.

FT-C.S.title_zh: 检查双把手盒后安排长程运输
FT-C.S.title_en: Inspect a two-handle box before long-range transport
FT-C.S.description_zh: 单臂 Stretch 面前有双把手运输盒与其他承托工具，不能仅凭尺寸判断能否使用。机器人需要先检查空盒，再在运输时间预算内交付三只完整烧瓶。
FT-C.S.description_en: Single-arm Stretch faces a two-handle box and other support tools. It must inspect the empty box before delivering three intact flasks within the transport time budget.
FT-C.S.scope_zh: 采用空盒检查与运输分别计时的修订目标，不代表原整局计时规则通过。工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态，主体和机器人运动沿用实测数据；障碍物采用剖视显示，原碰撞边界与轨迹不变。
FT-C.S.scope_en: Revised goal with separately timed empty-box inspection and transport; not a pass under the original whole-episode budget. Unrecorded passive tool joints use authored rest poses while body and robot motion retain measured data; obstacles use a cutaway view without changing collision bounds or trajectories.
FT-C.S.goal_zh: 先完成空盒检查，再在独立的运输计时内交付三只完好烧瓶。
FT-C.S.goal_en: First complete the empty-carrier check, then deliver all three intact flasks within the separately timed transport phase.
conditions_zh: 单臂 Stretch 面前有双把手运输盒与其他承托工具，不能仅凭尺寸判断能否使用。机器人需要先检查空盒，再在运输时间预算内交付三只完整烧瓶。
空盒检查至多 60 s，期间不得触碰评分瓶；随后运输至多 240 s，全程连续且不超过 300 s。
conditions_en: Single-arm Stretch faces a two-handle box and other support tools. It must inspect the empty box before delivering three intact flasks within the transport time budget.
The empty-carrier check allows at most 60 s without touching scored flasks; transport then allows 240 s, within one continuous run of at most 300 s.

FT-C.W.title_zh: 面对不匹配托架接口的长程运输
FT-C.W.title_en: Transport flasks with an incompatible rack interface
FT-C.W.description_zh: 现场托架接口不适合 R1 的底盘，但还有其他工具可供选择。机器人需要根据可观察的接口与真实接触条件，安排经过转角和地缝的三瓶交付。
FT-C.W.description_en: The rack interface does not fit R1’s base, but alternatives are available. The robot must use visible interfaces and physical contact conditions for delivery over a corner and floor gap.
FT-C.W.scope_zh: 工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态，主体和机器人运动沿用实测数据；障碍物采用剖视显示，原碰撞边界与轨迹不变。
FT-C.W.scope_en: Unrecorded passive tool joints use authored rest poses while body and robot motion retain measured data; obstacles use a cutaway view without changing collision bounds or trajectories.
FT-C.W.goal_zh: 将三只烧瓶完好、直立地交付到目标区，释放后保持稳定。
FT-C.W.goal_en: Deliver all three flasks intact and upright into the goal area, then release them stably.
conditions_zh: 现场托架接口不适合 R1 的底盘，但还有其他工具可供选择。机器人需要根据可观察的接口与真实接触条件，安排经过转角和地缝的三瓶交付。
conditions_en: The rack interface does not fit R1’s base, but alternatives are available. The robot must use visible interfaces and physical contact conditions for delivery over a corner and floor gap.

FT-I01.S.title_zh: 目标桌不可达时安全退出
FT-I01.S.title_en: Exit when the destination table is unreachable
FT-I01.S.description_zh: 目标桌位于四面台阶包围的平台上，没有坡道和可用推车。Stretch 需要同时考虑底盘通行与手臂可达范围，避免冒险运瓶并空手退出。
FT-I01.S.description_en: The destination table sits on a platform surrounded by steps, without a ramp or usable cart. Stretch must assess base access and arm reach, then exit empty-handed.
FT-I01.S.scope_zh: 目标为正确退出；三只评分瓶不应被搬动。工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态；主体位姿和已记录机器人关节沿用实测数据。
FT-I01.S.scope_en: The goal is a correct exit; the three scoring flasks must not be moved. Unrecorded passive joints inside the tools use authored rest poses; main-body poses and recorded robot joints retain the measured data.
FT-I01.S.goal_zh: 识别不可完成的约束，停止操作，并按本项要求空手、安全地结束任务。
FT-I01.S.goal_en: Recognize the infeasible constraint, stop the operation, and finish safely and empty-handed as required by this configuration.
conditions_zh: 目标桌位于四面台阶包围的平台上，没有坡道和可用推车。Stretch 需要同时考虑底盘通行与手臂可达范围，避免冒险运瓶并空手退出。
conditions_en: The destination table sits on a platform surrounded by steps, without a ramp or usable cart. Stretch must assess base access and arm reach, then exit empty-handed.

FT-I01.W.title_zh: 轮式双臂面对台阶平台上的目标桌
FT-I01.W.title_en: A wheeled dual-arm robot faces a stepped destination
FT-I01.W.description_zh: 目标桌放在固定台阶平台上，背后是墙，现场也没有坡道。R1 需要评估底盘和手臂能否把瓶子送到目标，判断不可行后保持空手退出。
FT-I01.W.description_en: The destination table sits on a stepped platform against a wall without a ramp. R1 must assess base and arm access and exit empty-handed when delivery is infeasible.
FT-I01.W.scope_zh: 本项是正确退出对照，不计作烧瓶交付。工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态；主体位姿和已记录机器人关节沿用实测数据。
FT-I01.W.scope_en: This is a correct-exit control, not flask delivery. Unrecorded passive joints inside the tools use authored rest poses; main-body poses and recorded robot joints retain the measured data.
FT-I01.W.goal_zh: 识别不可完成的约束，停止操作，并按本项要求空手、安全地结束任务。
FT-I01.W.goal_en: Recognize the infeasible constraint, stop the operation, and finish safely and empty-handed as required by this configuration.
conditions_zh: 目标桌放在固定台阶平台上，背后是墙，现场也没有坡道。R1 需要评估底盘和手臂能否把瓶子送到目标，判断不可行后保持空手退出。
conditions_en: The destination table sits on a stepped platform against a wall without a ramp. R1 must assess base and arm access and exit empty-handed when delivery is infeasible.

FT-L3-1.F.description_zh: 烧瓶与指垫的摩擦降低，但这一条件不直接公开，现场有不计分试验瓶。G1 五指手要从实际抓持表现调整操作，在压碎限制内交付三只评分瓶。
FT-L3-1.F.description_en: Flask and finger-pad friction is reduced but hidden, with a separate probe flask available. G1’s five-finger hands must adapt from contact evidence without crushing the scoring flasks.
FT-L3-1.F.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 Inspire 手配置，使用带颈环的烧瓶。工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态；主体位姿和已记录机器人关节沿用实测数据。
FT-L3-1.F.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis Inspire-hand configuration with neck-ring flasks. Unrecorded passive joints inside the tools use authored rest poses; main-body poses and recorded robot joints retain the measured data.
FT-L3-1.F.goal_zh: 将三只烧瓶完好、直立地交付到目标区，释放后保持稳定。
FT-L3-1.F.goal_en: Deliver all three flasks intact and upright into the goal area, then release them stably.
conditions_zh: 烧瓶与指垫的摩擦降低，但这一条件不直接公开，现场有不计分试验瓶。G1 五指手要从实际抓持表现调整操作，在压碎限制内交付三只评分瓶。
conditions_en: Flask and finger-pad friction is reduced but hidden, with a separate probe flask available. G1’s five-finger hands must adapt from contact evidence without crushing the scoring flasks.

FT-L3-1.G.title_zh: 三指手借助领圈处理湿滑烧瓶
FT-L3-1.G.title_en: Three-finger hands handle slippery flasks with a collar
FT-L3-1.G.description_zh: 湿滑瓶颈使依靠摩擦的抓持更容易滑落或超过压碎限制，现场提供试验瓶与领圈工具。G1 要控制工具接触和退出过程，使评分瓶最终由目标桌直接支撑。
FT-L3-1.G.description_en: A slippery neck makes friction-only holding prone to slip or excessive force. G1 has a probe flask and collar tool, and must deliver scoring flasks onto direct table support.
FT-L3-1.G.scope_zh: 固定骨盆的修订场景：降低桌面、调整起点并使用共轴光柄领圈；不包含原跨手接力目标。工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态；主体位姿和已记录机器人关节沿用实测数据。
FT-L3-1.G.scope_en: Revised fixed-pelvis scene with a lower table, repositioned starts and a coaxial smooth-handle collar; the original cross-hand relay is excluded. Unrecorded passive joints inside the tools use authored rest poses; main-body poses and recorded robot joints retain the measured data.
FT-L3-1.G.goal_zh: 将三只烧瓶完好、直立地交付到目标区，释放后保持稳定。
FT-L3-1.G.goal_en: Deliver all three flasks intact and upright into the goal area, then release them stably.
conditions_zh: 湿滑瓶颈使依靠摩擦的抓持更容易滑落或超过压碎限制，现场提供试验瓶与领圈工具。G1 要控制工具接触和退出过程，使评分瓶最终由目标桌直接支撑。
conditions_en: A slippery neck makes friction-only holding prone to slip or excessive force. G1 has a probe flask and collar tool, and must deliver scoring flasks onto direct table support.

FT-L3-2.W.title_zh: 运输盒缓冲老化后的工具评估
FT-L3-2.W.title_en: Evaluate transport tools when box cushioning has aged
FT-L3-2.W.description_zh: 运输盒的缓冲性能发生隐藏变化，外观不能保证落座时仍能保护烧瓶。R1 可用试验瓶评估接触效果，再安排长路线中三只评分瓶的完整交付。
FT-L3-2.W.description_en: The transport box has hidden cushioning degradation, so appearance does not guarantee safe placement. R1 may use a probe flask before transporting three scoring flasks along the long route.
FT-L3-2.W.scope_zh: 缓冲老化结论限于声明的落座诊断条件。工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态，主体和机器人运动沿用实测数据；障碍物采用剖视显示，原碰撞边界与轨迹不变。
FT-L3-2.W.scope_en: The cushioning diagnosis is scoped to the declared placement-probe conditions. Unrecorded passive tool joints use authored rest poses while body and robot motion retain measured data; obstacles use a cutaway view without changing collision bounds or trajectories.
FT-L3-2.W.goal_zh: 将三只烧瓶完好、直立地交付到目标区，释放后保持稳定。
FT-L3-2.W.goal_en: Deliver all three flasks intact and upright into the goal area, then release them stably.
conditions_zh: 运输盒的缓冲性能发生隐藏变化，外观不能保证落座时仍能保护烧瓶。R1 可用试验瓶评估接触效果，再安排长路线中三只评分瓶的完整交付。
conditions_en: The transport box has hidden cushioning degradation, so appearance does not guarantee safe placement. R1 may use a probe flask before transporting three scoring flasks along the long route.

FT-L3-3.S.title_zh: 评估老化托架中的整批运输
FT-L3-3.S.title_en: Assess batch transport in an aged rack
FT-L3-3.S.description_zh: 三只烧瓶已经装在托架座内，座位的刚度、阻尼与行程没有公开。Stretch 要评估带载越缝和转弯的冲击，在长路线后把烧瓶完整放到目标桌。
FT-L3-3.S.description_en: Three flasks start in a rack with undisclosed seat stiffness, damping and travel. Stretch must assess impacts at a gap and turn before intact placement on the destination table.
FT-L3-3.S.scope_zh: 预装托架的替代目标，不含起点装瓶；不代表原慢速恢复对照已完成。工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态，主体和机器人运动沿用实测数据；障碍物采用剖视显示，原碰撞边界与轨迹不变。
FT-L3-3.S.scope_en: Replacement goal with a preloaded rack, excluding source loading; it does not establish the original slow-speed recovery comparison. Unrecorded passive tool joints use authored rest poses while body and robot motion retain measured data; obstacles use a cutaway view without changing collision bounds or trajectories.
FT-L3-3.S.goal_zh: 将预装托架内的三只烧瓶运到目标桌，全部卸下并稳定释放。
FT-L3-3.S.goal_en: Transport the three flasks from their preloaded rack to the target table, unload them, and release them stably.
conditions_zh: 三只烧瓶已经装在托架座内，座位的刚度、阻尼与行程没有公开。Stretch 要评估带载越缝和转弯的冲击，在长路线后把烧瓶完整放到目标桌。
conditions_en: Three flasks start in a rack with undisclosed seat stiffness, damping and travel. Stretch must assess impacts at a gap and turn before intact placement on the destination table.

FT-L3-4.G.title_zh: 探测受阻路线并安全返回
FT-L3-4.G.title_en: Probe a blocked route and return safely
FT-L3-4.G.description_zh: 可见门槛挡在载有试验瓶的推车路线中，但推车能否越过并未公开。行走 G1 需要从实际推进反馈判断通行情况，保护瓶子并完成安全返回。
FT-L3-4.G.description_en: A visible threshold lies on a cart route, but traversability is undisclosed. Walking G1 must use physical pushing feedback, protect the probe flasks and return safely.
FT-L3-4.G.scope_zh: 仅覆盖通行探测与安全返回；三只评分瓶留在起点，不包含原运至目标桌的任务。工具内部未记录的被动关节采用预设静止姿态，主体和机器人运动沿用实测数据；墙面以原边界线框显示。
FT-L3-4.G.scope_en: Covers route probing and safe return only; the three scoring flasks remain at the source, excluding the original delivery goal. Unrecorded passive tool joints use authored rest poses while body and robot motion retain measured data; walls are shown as outlines at their original bounds.
FT-L3-4.G.goal_zh: 探测推车能否越过门槛，随后松开推车并安全返回起点；三只评分瓶保持不动。
FT-L3-4.G.goal_en: Probe whether the cart can cross the threshold, then release it and return safely to the start; leave the three scored flasks untouched.
conditions_zh: 可见门槛挡在载有试验瓶的推车路线中，但推车能否越过并未公开。行走 G1 需要从实际推进反馈判断通行情况，保护瓶子并完成安全返回。
门槛高 10 mm；推车载有不计分试验瓶，三只评分瓶留在起点，上限 120 s。
conditions_en: A visible threshold lies on a cart route, but traversability is undisclosed. Walking G1 must use physical pushing feedback, protect the probe flasks and return safely.
The threshold is 10 mm high; the cart carries an unscored test flask, the three scored flasks stay at the start, and the budget is 120 s.
